name: upscale-image-seedvr2
title: Upscale an image 2 or 4 times with SeedVR2
description: Raises the resolution of one image by 2 or 4 times with SeedVR2, a one-step diffusion restorer. The model file is an input, so the same graph runs the 3B and the 7B model. Built from Comfy's template utility_seedvr2_3b_int8_upscale_image.
